subject.title: [Feature]: Merge Skills, Plugins, and Skill Workshop into one Plugins hub

question: Should Skills and Skill Workshop become tabs under the Plugins sidebar destination while their existing URLs remain stable?
rationale: The proposed structure is technically compatible with current routing and aligns with frontend ergonomics, but choosing the permanent top-level navigation model requires maintainer product intent.

options.title: Adopt the Plugins hub
options.body: Land the linked PR after review and use Plugins as the single sidebar destination for installed plugins, discovery, skills, and workshop.

options.title: Keep separate destinations
options.body: Retain the current sidebar structure and extract only the Workshop loading-loop repair into a narrower change.

recommendation.title: Adopt the Plugins hub
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after review and use Plugins as the single sidebar destination for installed plugins, discovery, skills, and workshop.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the current UI feature set and recently maintained the sidebar surface where the product decision applies.
